name: When should I consider installing or replacing my interior window sills?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider installing or replacing my interior window sills?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider installing or replacing interior window sills if your current sills show signs of damage like warping, rotting, cracking, or water stains, or if you're undertaking a home renovation project. New sills can enhance insulation, protect the wall below the window, and improve the room's overall aesthetic. If you notice drafts or moisture issues around your windows, addressing the sill can be part of a larger solution to improve your home's energy efficiency and prevent further damage. Often, replacing sills during a window replacement project is a practical approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider installing or replacing interior window sills when they show damage, during renovations, or to improve insulation and aesthetics. This can also address drafts and moisture.
